incidents.summary: Former Foxtons employees alleged sexual harassment and racism spanning 2021–2024, with further complainants coming forward in April 2025; Foxtons said it had investigated and taken action where incidents were reported.

sources.title: More former Foxtons staff allege sexual harassment & racism | HR Management | HR Grapevine | News
sources.quote: Two further former employees of Foxtons have come forward with allegations of sexual harassment and racism, weeks after a Bloomberg investigation first detailed claims of groping, sexual propositions, and racist language.

sources.title: Foxtons implicated in harassment scandal - PropertyWire
sources.quote: The allegations took place between 2021 and late 2024.

sources.title: Ex-Foxtons staff allege sexual harassment and racism at the estate agency – The Property Managers
sources.quote: We have investigated and taken robust action where these incidents have been reported.

positives: Foxtons partnered with Kamma to give all its agents access to regulatory compliance management and checking services.
